timeout.recommendation: Add timeout for storage operations; for S3/MinIO the SDK may have defaults but they should be explicitly configured

retry.recommendation: Add retry with exponential backoff for transient storage failures

circuit_breaker.recommendation: Low priority - avatar operations are infrequent and non-critical

fallback.behavior: DeleteAvatar gracefully handles os.ErrNotExist (file already gone)
fallback.recommendation: UploadAvatar has no fallback - transaction rolls back DB changes if storage fails

idempotency.reason: Avatar upload overwrites existing file; delete is idempotent

blast_radius.impact: Avatar upload/delete fails; org continues to function with old/default avatar

findings.detail: Pure database read with no external dependencies

endpoint_resiliency.graceful_degradation: Returns error if DB is down

findings.detail: Background deletion of repos is not atomic - partial deletion leaves org in inconsistent state with some repos deleted and others remaining
findings.recommendation: Already handles this by continuing on failure and logging system notices; consider adding a status tracking mechanism

findings.detail: Calling DELETE /repos twice could trigger a second background deletion while first is still running
findings.recommendation: Add a lock or status check to prevent concurrent deletion operations on same org

non_atomic_operations: Sequential repo deletion in background - partial failure leaves some repos deleted, others intact
endpoint_resiliency.cascading_failure_risk: Background goroutine uses graceful shutdown context; if server shuts down mid-deletion, remaining repos are not deleted
endpoint_resiliency.graceful_degradation: Errors logged as system notices; individual repo failures don't stop other deletions

findings.detail: DB update and storage write are in same transaction; if storage fails, DB rolls back
No explicit timeout on storage write operation

endpoint_resiliency.cascading_failure_risk: Storage backend failure causes avatar upload to fail; org remains functional
endpoint_resiliency.graceful_degradation: Falls back to default avatar if upload fails

findings.detail: Gracefully handles os.ErrNotExist when avatar file is already gone

non_atomic_operations: DB update and storage delete in transaction - if storage delete fails (non-ErrNotExist), transaction rolls back
endpoint_resiliency.cascading_failure_risk: Minimal - worst case avatar file remains on storage but DB marks it as deleted

findings.detail: PUT is idempotent - calling multiple times with same data produces same result (upsert pattern)

health_checks.recommendation: Version endpoint serves as basic liveness; no dedicated readiness probe

graceful_shutdown.detail: graceful.GetManager() provides shutdown context; background tasks use ShutdownContext()

rate_limiting.detail: No built-in rate limiting on API endpoints
rate_limiting.recommendation: Consider adding rate limiting middleware or relying on reverse proxy

dead_letter_queues.detail: No message queues used in these endpoints; background deletion logs failures as system notices

single_points_of_failure: Database - all endpoints depend on it with no caching layer
cascading_failure_paths: Database down → all 7 endpoints fail immediately
Storage backend down → ep-037/ep-038 fail, others unaffected
